api_db.title: OAuth API + Database
api_db.intro: Use Zoho OAuth client credentials stored in the database, then authorize to save tokens.

steps.title: Create Zoho OAuth client
paragraphs: In Zoho API Console, create a Server-based client and note Client ID and Client Secret.

steps.title: Region and redirect URI
paragraphs: Select the correct Zoho region, add the redirect URI shown in this plugin, then paste credentials in Database mode.

steps.title: Verify and authorize
paragraphs: Verify credentials, then Authorize to complete OAuth and store tokens.

api_wp_config.title: OAuth API + wp-config.php
api_wp_config.intro: Store OAuth client credentials as wp-config constants; tokens are still saved after authorization.

steps.title: Add client constants
paragraphs: Copy the generated BOOLEANSMTP_ZOHO_* constants into wp-config.php.

steps.title: WP Config storage mode
paragraphs: Switch to WP Config, confirm the checkbox, then verify and authorize.

smtp_db.title: SMTP + Database
smtp_db.intro: Use Zoho SMTP with username/password stored in the database.

steps.title: App password
paragraphs: If required by your account, generate an app password for SMTP authentication.

steps.title: Endpoint and credentials
paragraphs: Choose SMTP mode, pick the endpoint preset, enter Zoho email and password in Database storage.

smtp_wp_config.title: SMTP + wp-config.php
smtp_wp_config.intro: Define SMTP credentials via wp-config constants instead of storing them in the database.

steps.title: Copy constants
paragraphs: Paste generated constants into wp-config.php and confirm the acknowledgement checkbox.
